name: usage_accumulate
description: Deterministic code_parallel decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

prevTokens.description: Running token total so far; coerced to 0 when not a non-boolean number.

newTokens.description: Tokens to add to the running total; coerced to 0 when not a non-boolean number.

prevCost.description: Running USD cost so far; coerced to 0 when not a non-boolean number.

newCost.description: USD cost to add to the running total; coerced to 0 when not a non-boolean number.

tokens.description: prevTokens + newTokens, after coercing non-numeric inputs to 0.

cost.description: prevCost + newCost, after coercing non-numeric inputs to 0.
